docs.abstract: Friday’s jobs report could bolster the view that the American economy is holding steady, but an oil price shock could undercut that sense of calm.

byline.original: By Andrew Ross Sorkin, Ravi Mattu, Bernhard Warner, Sarah Kessler, Michael J. de la Merced, Lauren Hirsch and Ephrat Livni

headline.main: Jobs and Oil Prices Are Keeping Markets on Edge

multimedia.caption: Economists expect today’s job report to maintain a sense of economic stability.
multimedia.credit: Scott McIntyre for The New York Times
